title: Create a Custom Admin Action
description: Add an action to mark selected posts as published.
problemStatement:
## Your Mission

Extend the `PostAdmin` from previous tasks by adding a custom admin action called `make_published` that sets `is_published = True` for all selected posts.

Provide a short description that appears in the action dropdown. Ensure the action appears only when at least one post is selected.
hints: Define a function `make_published(modeladmin, request, queryset)` that calls `queryset.update(is_published=True)`.
Add the function to the `actions` list in the ModelAdmin.
expectedOutput: In the admin list view, after selecting some posts, the action dropdown includes 'Mark selected posts as published'. Choosing it updates the selected posts.
solutionCode:
# admin.py
from django.contrib import admin
from .models import Post

def make_published(modeladmin, request, queryset):
    queryset.update(is_published=True)
make_published.short_description = "Mark selected posts as published"

@admin.register(Post)
class PostAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ('title', 'author', 'published_date', 'is_published')
    list_filter = ('is_published', 'author')
    search_fields = ('title', 'content')
    ordering = ('-published_date',)
    actions = [make_published]
